segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func animateWithSpringEffect() { /// A spring coefficient for a spring animation effect, /// in newtons per meter. let stiffness: Double = 200 /// The damping factor of a spring animation's effect, /// in newton-seconds per meter. let damping: Double = 10 let spring = Spring(stiffness: stiffness, damping: damping) let springAnimation = Animation.interpolatingSpring(spring).delay(1.0) // Animate the text popping out of the window with a spring effect. withAnimation(springAnimation) { animationProgress = 1.0 } } ```
